02 / THE FOUNDATION

Human purpose.
Useful tools.

01

People lead

Show staff, contributors and local teams as decision makers. Technology supports their work.

Proposed convention
02

Evidence stays visible

Every claim needs a source, a date and a scope. Estimates and unresolved questions remain explicit.

Proposed convention
03

Responsibility is named

Tools have maintainers. Releases have approvers. A polished screen is never a substitute for ownership.

Proposed convention

03 / COLOUR

A brighter kind of clarity.

Download CSS ↗

Values observed in the current WaterAid Canada website. The roles below are our proposed application of those values.

Use with intention. Ink on cream. White on blue. Ink on lime. Avoid white text on lime. Colour always works alongside a text label.

04 / TYPOGRAPHY

Bold headlines.
Easy reading.

Observed on official site

RB Nylo Black

Current website display and headline family. RB Nylo is not bundled; its licence remains to be confirmed.

Every idea
needs a voice.
This guide uses Noto Sans Black as an open-licensed substitute, not RB Nylo.
Observed on official site

Noto Sans

Current website body family. The guide now uses self-hosted Noto Sans, distributed under the SIL Open Font License.

Clear information helps people act with confidence. Keep the language familiar, the next step visible and the evidence close.
Proposed UI baseline: 16px body, generous line height, sentence case.

Connection details ↓

Streamable HTTP · no authentication · read-only

get_brand_systemlist_assetsget_assetget_ui_guidanceget_document_guidance

Ask your agent to read the brand system and choose an asset from the catalogue before it builds a screen.

Read the WaterAid brand MCP before building. For every PDF or document, call get_document_guidance, use the reference layout, embed the original logo and render-check every page. Use its exact colour tokens, typography and component guidance. Choose logos and icons from its asset catalogue; preserve their aspect ratios and use the correct background. Keep fictional case data labelled.

10 / GOVERNANCE

Clear about what we know.

Official

Explicit WaterAid publications, with region and context retained.

Observed

Styling and assets inspected on the live site. Useful evidence, not a full brand specification.

Proposed

Wetland-specific design choices for the team to review and improve.

Keep the case study separate. Water Care Canada and Kijana are fictional challenge entities. This hub contains no case-pack data or organiser-only material.
What needs confirmation before official use?

Current Canada/federation brand guide; authorised logo set and spacing rules; RB Nylo font licensing; photography permissions; French language conventions; named brand owner and release approval.
